text: player
The Louder the Salesman, the Bigger the Lie
Gintoki Sakata
So? Where exactly are the Scoundrel Three?
Somewhere in One Han City
Heard they're around here somewhere...
Ichihime
I'm not really sure either, nyaa.
Then let's ask around.//nOi you! You look like someone who knows things!
Osamu Saitou
What is it?
It's the big boss, nyaa! Hello, nyaa!
Priestess, what a coincidence.
You know each other? That makes things easier.
We're looking for the Scoundrel Three, nyaa. Have you seen them, nyaa?
Oh, that again...
Again?
Lots of people are looking for that guy lately. Didn't expect you'd want that stuff too...
Wait just a second, I don't think I'm following.
We heard the Scoundrel Three were causing trouble, so we hired Gin from the Odd Jobs, nyaa!
The Odd Jobs? Like any kind of job?
Gin has solved all sorts of problems in his world. He's basically the guy you call when you need something done.
Hi there, I'm Gintoki Sakata of the Odd Jobs.
Osamu Saitou
Pleasure, I'm Osamu Saitou.
Solving problems is what I do. Now that you've come to me, you're in good hands!
...//n(This mop top... can he actually deliver?)
Oi, are you doubting me? Think I can't tell? It's written all over your face!
Come with me.
Hey! Wait a second! Don't ignore me!
Quite the lively scene here.
This place only opened recently, but it's already packed all day.
What's causing this craze, nyaa?
They say it's a juice that boosts mahjong luck.
Juice?! I want it too, nyaa!
Hey! Running off to buy it already?!
Wanjirou
Gimme seven bottles of that "Lucky Juice," woof!
Sawako Kitami
A dozen for me, please!
Mai Aihara
I-I'll take a whole case! Please...!
Nyaa?! About to sell out already! Gotta buy now, nyaa!//nHello, I'll take the rest, nyaa!
Tatsuma Sakamoto
Oh! Lady Ichihime! Thank you for your support! I'll go get them ready. Please just wait in line for a moment.
Huh! What're you doing here?!
Oh, Kintoki! Can't believe I'd see you here!
Not Kintoki, it's Gintoki! What the heck are you doing here?!
Doing business, of course. What else could it be? Wound up in this One Han City somehow.//nTook me a hot minute to get my bearings, but now I'm back in the game.
Lucky for me, my cargo hitched a ride to this world. Figured why not set up a shop right here.
So you started scamming people with this "luck-boosting" snake oil?
Hey now, careful with your phrasing! Nobody's scamming anyone! Why don't you hear what my customers have to say!
I feel like my stomach is working a lot better, woof!
Ever since drinking this juice, my skin's been glowing like never before.
I-I saw Miss Hibiki Himekawa recommending it on CatChat, so...
Ahahaha! Lady Himekawa sure is One Han City's Internet queen! That endorsement deal was worth every penny!
Hold up – the juice is popular, but since when does it have anything to do with boosting luck?

You're thinking about the luck part all wrong! See, my juice makes you healthier. When you're healthier, you're more focused. When you're more focused, you play better. When you play better, you win more. Simple as that.
Huh? So I win more... but it's not because my luck got better, nyaa?
Sounds like a scam...
Lucky Juice? More like repackaged surplus stock you're scamming folks with!
Ahahahaha!
Ahahahahahaha!
Ahahahahahahahahahahaha!
The hell you're laughing at! So you ARE dumping old inventory!
Well, I think I know what's going on now.
Still, everyone seems pretty happy with it, nyaa. I don't think Mr. Sakamoto quite hit the "Scoundrel" territory yet?

The issue is his personal conduct.//nIt's the same thing every night... he gets blind drunk, causes a scene, and often ends up stumbling through the streets half-dressed, dancing and singing to himself.
Haha, my bad, my bad. I repent every morning... but once the drinks flow, all bets are off!
You've got zero remorse. Time to learn when to quit.
Right back at you!
Master, what now, nyaa?
Well...
Maybe we should send Mr. Sakamoto back.
Mr. Saitou, what do you think?
The drunken antics have gone too far. Best send him back.
Many probably want Mr. Sakamoto to stay in One Han City... What's your take, Mr. Saitou?
Every place has its rules. No matter how good his products are, we can't let him disrupt public order.
Let him return to his world and rethink his business strategy. If it benefits One Han City, he's always welcome to come back.
I see. A true entrepreneur, indeed. I'm with Mr. Saitou on this one.
Alright Gin, it's in your hands now.
Alright alright, off you go now.
No way am I going back! You see...
Leaving already, woof?!
What a shame...
Without this juice... wh-what am I supposed to do...!
A real businessman fulfills customers' demands! Where there's need, there's me! That's why I'm not going anywhere!
Well then, how about we settle this with a match? They say nothing in One Han City can't be solved by mahjong – let's follow tradition.
Hey, are you sure about challenging him, woof?
Don't forget that Mr. Sakamoto has the "Lucky Juice"!
Mr. Sakamoto will absolutely win!
In that case, you've got no excuse to run, huh?
Gulp gulp gulp... Aha!//nWith this "Lucky Juice" in me, I'm invincible! I accept your challenge!
That's the spirit. Now, let's settle it with this.
Fist... that's how you want to settle it? A fight?
No, it's rock-paper-scissors.
Oh? Interesting. Don't be a crybaby when you lose.
Well, let's begin! Rock, paper...
Scissors!
What? How?!
Well, I'm the winner.
Then please return to your own world.
Wait! One more round!
You just won't give up, huh? Fine, again. Rock, paper...
Scissors!
Impossible! O-one more time!
Rock, paper...
Scissors! Scissors! Scissors! Scissors...
Nooooo! I've lost it all!
With all that "Lucky Juice" inside him...
Mr. Sakamoto got completely crushed, nyaa...
He just proved his own marketing claims are entirely fake.
Well, well, turns out it was fake!
So disappointed, woof.
How could it be...! I believed in that juice so much...!
Everyone, time to head home, woof.
Whaaat?! Don't go, everyone!!
Well, all the regulars vanished just like that.
Why?! Why can't I win at all?! Has the goddess of fortune abandoned me?!
No, it's not that.
Huh?! Who's talking?!
It's me.
Cobra?!
Not Cobra, it's Katsura!
His promotion's over the top, but the business itself is legitimate.
Gintoki Sakata & Tatsuma Sakamoto
Kotaro Katsura
